summary: auth-service began failing health checks after a config change altered the token-signing key rotation interval, but the process never crashed and recovered on its own once the config was reverted.
root_cause: A config change set the token-signing key rotation interval too aggressively, causing intermittent signature validation failures on health check requests, without ever crashing the process.
fix: Reverted the rotation interval config; no restart was required since the process remained healthy throughout.
